releases.body:
### Fixed
- Fixed hook session-key resolution so stable runtime IDs take precedence over transcript paths when a payload contains both, preventing one long-running Codex thread from alternating between writer and fallback identities across hook processes.
- Published the receipt-based Codex writer handoff and wildcard `PostToolUse` coverage under a fresh plugin version so upgrades create a new cache instead of retaining a stale or partial `0.8.9` install.

### Fixed
- Fixed automatic task initialization guidance so simple prompts no longer lead directly to task opt-in or title/slug questions; all hosts now use the same `skip` / `offer` / `explicit` tracking recommendation.
- Fixed writer binding and repository registration races by locking each full read-check-write transaction across the workspace.
- Fixed multi-repo task switching so `--stash` handles every dirty repo checkout instead of calling Git with an empty aggregate root.
- Fixed lifecycle safety: resume binds before mutating task files, archive requires `done`, and init refuses to overwrite an existing slug.
- Fixed verification completion false positives by requiring exact success tokens instead of substring matches.
- Fixed Codex fallback handoff by replacing shell-text inference with short-lived receipts claimed atomically on `PostToolUse`, and matching all supported canonical tool events so MCP mutations are tracked.

### Changed
- Automatic skill selection now evaluates whether durable tracking would help before prompting: simple work stays quiet, `offer` asks for opt-in, and explicit task-init requests proceed to title/slug confirmation.

### Added
- Added concurrency, lifecycle, negative verification, multi-repo stash, and Codex handoff regression tests, plus pull-request pytest CI.

### Fixed
- Updated the Codex plugin installer to tolerate current Codex CLI builds that expose marketplace management but no non-interactive plugin install command.

### Changed
- Clarified Codex plugin installation docs for the latest marketplace-plus-`/plugins` flow and the `hooks` / `codex_hooks` feature-key transition.
- Clarified that `install-codex-plugin.sh` is the project-local Codex install wrapper, not the general Codex marketplace install command.
- Added Codex marketplace root metadata so `codex plugin marketplace add excitedhaha/context-task-planning` can be the primary install path, with `/plugins` used to install or enable the plugin.
- Clarified that Codex plugins can be enabled from the Codex app plugin browser or the CLI `/plugins` surface after marketplace registration.

### Fixed
- Fixed OpenCode session resolution so event IDs such as `evt_*` are not passed to session title APIs that require `ses*` session IDs.

### Added
- Added Codex `SubagentStart` hook support so native Codex subagents receive a concise current-task guardrail for explicit task bindings.
- Added Codex plugin install-surface metadata through `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` `interface` fields.
- Fixed the Codex plugin manifest to use the runtime-compatible single `skills` path and documented the local Codex marketplace-wrapper install path.
- Added `skill/scripts/install-codex-plugin.sh` to install the repository-root Codex plugin through a stable local marketplace wrapper.

### Changed
- Moved Codex hooks configuration to `skill/codex-hooks/hooks.json`, updated the plugin manifest to point there, and switched hook commands to `${PLUGIN_ROOT}`.
- Extended Codex `SessionStart` hook matching to include compact recovery.
- Updated Codex docs and smoke tests for the canonical `hooks` feature key; `codex_hooks` remains documented only as a deprecated alias.

### Removed
- Removed the obsolete `.codex-plugin/hooks.json` hook config file. Upgrading users must review and trust the changed plugin hook definitions in `/hooks`.
